trackingId.description: Unique identifier to track the flow of HTTP requests.

sourceUserId.description: Unique identifier of the user who ran the job.

sourceCustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the customer who ran the job.

targetCustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the customer for whom the job was run.

instanceId.description: Unique identifier of the job instance.

jobExecutionStatus.description: Most recent step's execution status, including statuses of all steps in the job execution.

latestExecutionStatus.description:
Most recent status of the job at the time of invocation.
 * `STARTING` - Job has started.
 * `STARTED` - Job is in progress.
 * `COMPLETED` - Job has completed.
 * `FAILED` - Job has failed.
 * `UNKNOWN` - Job status is unknown.
 * `ABANDONED` - Job has been abandoned (manually stopped).

latestExecutionExitCode.description:
Most recent exit code of the job at the time of invocation.
 * `UNKNOWN` - Job is in progress.
 * `COMPLETED` - Job has completed successfully.
 * `FAILED` - Job has failed.
 * `STOPPED` - Job has been stopped.
 * `COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS` - Job has completed with errors.
 * `COMPLETED_WITH_PENDING_ORDERS` - Job has completed with pending number orders.
